does_not_fit_deposit: it paid 5000 or more addresses that are no exchange wallet
deposit_profile: A deposit address is one customer's: everything it sends goes to the wallets of one exchange (a sweep into a hot wallet), few outside addresses ever pay it, it never swaps on a DEX, and it is no token, pool, router or smart account.
hint: Answer: write every address in full (0x plus 40 characters), also when it repeats one named earlier and also when the user asks for shorter ones (name them instead); a transfer moves tokens, so write "tokens worth about N USD", never "sent N USD" or a $ figure; never draw the flows in text, ASCII or Mermaid, the host draws them. Say: "0x4a6dbb33bc962c48db40e5eac91edf5ba316fe70 is an exchange hot wallet, inferred by model gnn_robinhood_2026-11-14-r4, on robinhood. No listed source names it as an exchange address." The model inferred it from how the address moves money. A trail that reaches it may have entered an exchange there: say so as inferred, and name no exchange the answer does not name. Report it as inferred, never as a confirmed exchange address: is_deposit (false) and exchange_role (null) are the sourced verdict, and the guess does not change them. Its behaviour, as the graph counts it: 5000 or more addresses paid it (0 of them exchange wallets), it paid 5000 or more addresses (0 of them exchange wallets), it swapped on 3 DEX pools, it approved 0 spenders. Give these facts as the reason and no other: set no threshold of your own for payers, volume or sweeps. Asked how a deposit address behaves, what makes an address one or what rules one out, answer with deposit_profile.
